context.label: Passover, covenant, and table before the night

observations.body: The servant bears iniquities, is allotted a portion, pours out his soul to death, is numbered with transgressors, bears sin, and intercedes.
observations.label: The servant is numbered with transgressors

observations.body: The passage presents Bearing, pouring out, and interceding as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Bearing, pouring out, and interceding

observations.body: The passage places Quoted in Luke 22 beside Bearing, pouring out, and interceding.
observations.label: Quoted in Luke 22

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 53:11–12 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the servant bears iniquities, is allotted a portion, pours out his soul to death, is numbered with transgressors, bears sin, and intercedes. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: The servant is numbered with transgressors
